1. Collection and Use of Personal Information
pages.content: Privacy Policy Elevation Group Arizona – Protecting Your Privacy At ElevationGroupAZ.com, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you visit our website or use our real estate services. 1. Collection and Use of Personal Information When you contact us through our website, schedule a consultation, or request property details, we may collect information such as your name, email address, phone number, and mailing address. We use this information only to respond to your inquiries, provide updates, and deliver professional real estate services tailored to your needs. 2. Non-Personal Information We may collect non-personal data such as your browser type, device, IP address, and the pages you visit on our site. This information helps us understand user behavior, improve website performance, and enhance your browsing experience. It is collected in aggregate form and not linked to any personally identifiable data. 3. Cookies Our website uses cookies to improve your experience and track how visitors interact with the site. Cookies are small files stored on your device that help remember your preferences and site activity. You can disable cookies anytime through your browser settings. 4. Sharing of Information We may share limited personal information with trusted third-party service providers who help us manage communication, marketing, or client relationship systems. These partners are required to maintain the confidentiality and security of your information. We never sell or trade your personal data to outside parties. 5. Data Security We take appropriate measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure. Sensitive data transmitted through our site is protected using secure encryption technology and stored in protected databases. 6. Children’s Privacy Our website and services are not intended for children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 13 years old. If you believe that we may have collected data from a child, please contact us right away so we can remove it promptly. 7. Updates to This Policy We may update or modify this Privacy Policy at any time. All changes will be posted on this page with the updated effective date. 8. Contact Us If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your information, please contact us at: Email: info@elevationgroupaz.com

pages.content: Elizabeth Flynn Assistant Individuals and families who work with Elizabeth Flynn appreciate her calm, thoughtful approach and her firsthand understanding of what it truly means to relocate. Raised in Connecticut in a family that owned and operated a real estate brokerage, Elizabeth was surrounded by real estate from an early age and earned her license there before her journey took her across the country. Her life and career have taken her from Connecticut to Minneapolis, then to Orange County, and ultimately to Scottsdale. Because of this, Elizabeth has personal experience with long distance moves, career driven relocations, and the challenges that come with settling into a new city. This allows her to guide clients with clarity, patience, and confidence through every step of the buying and selling process. Now living in Scottsdale with her husband of 13 years and their two children, Elizabeth brings both industry knowledge and real life relocation experience to her clients. She is known for her detail oriented, relationship driven approach and her commitment to making every transaction as smooth and stress free as possible. Your Trusted Partner in Real Estate & Relocation Elizabeth is passionate about helping individuals and families make confident real estate decisions. Whether you are relocating to Arizona, buying your first home, or preparing to sell, she provides honest guidance, strong communication, and reliable support from start to finish. She believes in staying connected even after the transaction is complete and takes pride in being a long term resource for her clients. If you have questions about buying, selling, relocating, or simply getting settled in your new area, Elizabeth would love to connect and help guide you through the process. just pick up the phone and call. 480-370-0941 Work With Elevation Group Assisting Buyers and Sellers of Exceptional Luxury Homes Providing expert professional service & representation With integrity, courtesy, and gratitude. pages.content: Scottsdale Real Estate Scottsdale, Arizona – Luxury Living in the Heart of the Desert Scottsdale, Arizona is one of the most desirable places to call home. Residents enjoy endless sunshine, breathtaking desert landscapes, and stunning views of Camelback Mountain that make every day feel like a getaway. Experience the Scottsdale Lifestyle Scottsdale offers something for everyone. Outdoor enthusiasts can explore scenic hiking trails, bike through desert parks, or play on championship golf courses surrounded by picturesque mountain backdrops. For those who prefer a refined lifestyle, the city features luxury shopping destinations, art galleries, and world-class spas. The dining scene is equally impressive, offering top-rated restaurants with locally inspired cuisine. When evening arrives, Scottsdale transforms into a hub of culture and entertainment, from lively music venues and elegant lounges to family-friendly events and festivals.
